name: Centrale nucleare în România
title: Centrale nucleare în România
description: Centrale nucleare în România — reactor-level list of nuclear power plant units from the GeoNuclearData database (WNA/IAEA-sourced), including shutdown and under-construction units with reactor type/model, construction and operational dates, and capacity (MW). Complements the power-plants datasets (which cover operating plants of all fuels, plant-level): this list is reactor-unit level and includes historical (shutdown) and future (under construction) units. Names are ASCII/English as published by the source; native-script names not in source. Snapshot at source commit date (2024-era database; per-record LastUpdatedAt varies).
